'''March 2001 Lompoc tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Lompoc, CA on 10 March 2001. [[Ed Herrara]] won it. It is known from Cat Ceder's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1889">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-13-lompoc-ca-03-10-01d1889/ lompoc-ca-03-10-01], DeckTech (Cat "CatLoneRogue" Ceder, 13 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-13-lompoc-ca-03-10-01d1889/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 10 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Lompoc, CA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Ed Herrara]]
